answer: Run a synchronized memory sprint each epoch: a VRF beacon, announced only 2 min ahead, opens one 10-minute window in which every key must fill a fresh 8 GiB memory-hard table and answer 20 random lookups in under 50 ms each. One box cannot serve N keys at once, so a harbor of aliases must keep N 16 GiB VMs on standby: about $0.60 per extra key per epoch, $60 for 100 keys, paid again every voyage. Failure mode: a reef of rented cloud boxes; the check is RTT and RAM-timing probes, and keys on one ASN with matching timing fingerprints get merged.
